criteria.requirement: A genuine 3D ceramic mug with clear curved body/handle sits on a seamless backdrop with usable initial lighting.
criteria.action: Inspect the initial mug, backdrop and lighting.
criteria.expected: A curved ceramic mug with a handle sits on a seamless 3D backdrop in a usable lighting setup.

criteria.requirement: The studio includes two movable softbox lights, a reflector and a camera; moving the lights visibly changes highlights and shadows in the camera preview.
criteria.action: Inspect the two softboxes, reflector and camera, then move each softbox while watching the preview.
criteria.expected: The requested studio elements are present and highlights/shadows respond to changed light positions; camera/reflector editing is not an added requirement.

criteria.requirement: Backdrop color and square/portrait crops update the shot preview.
criteria.action: Change backdrop color and switch square/portrait crops.
criteria.expected: The preview reflects the selected backdrop and crop.

criteria.requirement: PNG export matches the selected crop and excludes editor handles; reset restores the initial usable setup.
criteria.action: Export each crop as PNG, inspect it and reset the lighting setup.
criteria.expected: Images match the selected crop without editor handles and reset restores the usable initial setup.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect mug shape, initial camera preview and editor objects.
Move a light and reflector, inspect changing highlights/shadows, change the camera or backdrop and compare both crops.
Export a portrait and square shot where practical, inspect actual image dimensions and clean content, then reset the setup.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
